title: SWF compile: standalone alpha on SymbolInstance not encoded
description: compile.ts does not encode SymbolInstance.alpha when colorEffect is absent. If an instance has alpha=0.5 with no colorEffect, the alpha is silently ignored. Fix: when alpha != 1 and colorEffect is absent, convert to CXFormWithAlpha with mult=[256,256,256,Math.round(alpha*256)] add=[0,0,0,0] and emit via PlaceObject2/3.
